evidence: Three RGCN attempts collapse to a constant (loss → ln 2).
metric: loss → 0.6931 (ln 2); scores min/max/mean/std 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.5 / 0.0; unique 1; after fix core 0.4401 / 0.4318
observation: Three RGCN attempts with dot-product, cosine or temperature-scaled decoders and weight decay collapsed to a constant: loss sat at ln 2 and every pair scored 0.5, which reads as AUPRC at the base rate. An MLP pair decoder with no weight decay removed the collapse and produced usable ranking.
subject: F-57
title: RGCN training pathology: constant 0.5 scores until the decoder was replaced
